source.stem: Which statement about pure water is not correct?

options.text: It turns cobalt(II) chloride paper blue.
It turns anhydrous copper(II) sulfate blue.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: water is the same as its neighbouring term in this chapter, so the decision does not change.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: The hydrosphere includes water in ponds, lakes, rivers, springs, seas, oceans, and groundwater.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: water supply and weather -> habitats for living beings happens first, and that produces sunlight, water movement, and air movement.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when The hydrosphere includes water in ponds, lakes, rivers, springs, seas, oceans, and groundwater is not true.

intelligence.enrichment: Water is essential for life and forms the hydrosphere; sunlight heats Earth, water vapour forms clouds and brings rain or snow that refills water sources, and rainfall helps determine which plants and animals can live in a place. sunlight, water movement, and air movement -> water supply and weather -> habitats for living beings The learner correctly uses the chapter relationship: Water is essential for life and forms the hydrosphere; sunlight heats Earth, water vapour forms clouds and brings rain or snow that refills water sources, and rainfall helps determine which plants and animals can live in a place. Because most of Earth has water, every place should support the same plants and animals.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Why Earth supports life. The student must decide: Decide how water, sunlight, and moving air help sustain life across Earth. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Retarget the source onto this Science decision. Keep the source item type. Recalculate the key.
